g.text: PARTIAL: 40/45 recorded runs; each point is one run, dark ticks are medians, lines show observed ranges
Recovery uses confirmed successes and 1 rps sampling; failed/unconfirmed counts remain in row labels.
Probe/token panels retain failures. Model fallbacks and diagnosis counts are in plot-data.json.
M0 is scripted; M1 selects observations, actions and verification; M2 ranks model hypotheses. These are local development results.
